name: Creating Accessible Scientific Figures
description:
Scientific journals require microscopy figures to be accessible to color-blind readers (avoiding Red/Green combinations) and to include visible scale bars. Transform the 'Fluorescent Cells' sample image into a publication-quality figure:

1. Open the 'Fluorescent Cells' sample (File > Open Samples).
2. Convert the image to Composite mode (Image > Color > Make Composite) or Split Channels to manipulate colors independently.
3. Change the LUT of the Red channel (Channel 1) to Magenta. Ensure the Green channel (Channel 2) remains Green.
4. Set the spatial calibration (Analyze > Set Scale): distance=1, known=0.16, unit=micron (0.16 µm/pixel).
5. Burn in a scale bar (Tools > Scale Bar): 10 µm width, White color, located in the Lower Right, Overlay disabled (or flatten afterwards).
6. Flatten the image (Image > Overlay > Flatten or Image > Type > RGB Color) to burn in the colors and scale bar.
7. Save the final RGB image as a PNG to ~/ImageJ_Data/results/accessible_figure.png.
